name: THOMAS
canonical: Thomas called Didymus the doubter, a tall lean Galilean of about thirty-five with sallow light-olive skin and a gaunt thoughtful face marked by a furrowed searching brow, restless sceptical deep-set grey eyes that seem to weigh and probe everything, dark hair receding slightly at the temples and a thin pointed dark beard, dressed in a sober slate-grey tunic and dark mantle, one hand half-raised with fingers as if reaching to verify by touch
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
